paths.name: @prisma/client
paths.message: Persistence belongs in src/server/. Import a query/repository from '@/server/...' instead, or add one there. See plans/DES-33_PLAN.md.

paths.name: @supabase/supabase-js
paths.message: Use the FileStorage port: import { storage } from '@/server/storage'. Only the Supabase adapter may import the SDK.

patterns.message: Persistence belongs in src/server/, and tenant data must go through the tenant-scoped client: `const { db } = tenantContext(session)` from '@/server/tenantDb'. Raw prisma is unscoped and reads across firms. See plans/DES-25_PLAN.md.
The platform client reads across every firm. Only the /admin console may use it. Firm-facing code wants `tenantContext(session)` from '@/server/tenantDb'. See plans/DES-26_PLAN.md.
